title: Six Flights rear-view candidate library, first pass
tool: Built-in OpenAI image generation; model and seed not exposed
count_definition: 132 labeled panels, not 132 separate native assets or unique silhouette families; near-duplicate alternatives remain identified. 24 shadow panels fail black-only production requirement. No panel is approved or production-ready.
front_pose_gate: Front-facing and three-quarter named-cast production remains held pending Fable review of the revised character sheet. No new front-facing named-cast production was generated.
references: C00-revised-adult-proportions.png, recovered existing sheet; approval not inferred
back-facing-contact-sheet.png, recovered existing five-figure starter set; used for cast-board styling
A3-gouache-roof.webp, viewed for visual context, not supplied to new generations
